brief: NVDA reinstated Jensen Huang as President, CEO and board member, effective immediately, after a unanimous board vote following discussions with Huang and input from senior US government officials that his reinstatement poses no national security risk. Colette Kress returns to CFO from interim CEO; Harvey Jones remains board chair. The independent board committee investigating reports that Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort continues its work, with Huang cooperating; NVDA also formed a National Security and Export Control Committee and is searching for a new Chief Compliance Officer. KeyBanc calls the reinstatement a significantly positive development but keeps its Sector Weight rating, citing uncertainty over what the board's investigation and the separate SEC accounting probe may still uncover, pending further clarification. KeyBanc's fair value is $160, 9x its FY28 EPS estimate of $16.99, versus peers' average consensus forward P/E of 26x; it still sees NVDA uniquely positioned on secular AI/data-center demand with CUDA as a durable competitive moat.
